name: DATABASE_URL
summary: Runtime and deployment migrations fetch this app's database locator from the vault into memory. Never read from env, including after vault failure.

name: MIGRATIONS_TEST_DATABASE_URL
summary: Explicit isolated-test database override, accepted only with NODE_ENV=test or CI=true (never NODE_ENV=production). Never a server env entry or a DATABASE_URL fallback. Deploy scrubs inherited overrides.

name: CI
summary: CI runner context for isolated migration tests only; never set in a server env file. It does not enable legacy DATABASE_URL input.

name: APP_DB_SCHEMA
summary: The one Postgres schema this app owns. Fixed to `market` — the existing prod/dev schema; never change it (it would orphan migration state).

name: AUTH_SERVICE_URL
summary: Kernel auth service base URL, including the /auth prefix. Read by @ima-jin/auth for session/app-token verification and kernel webhook public signing-key discovery.

name: IMAJIN_APP_AUD
summary: Published SDK override for the scoped app-token audience (default registry slug market). Never a shared path-routed kernel host. Unset for normal market deployments. This is not the webhook audience, which remains IMAJIN_APP_DID.

name: IMAJIN_AUTH_URL
summary: Kernel base URL for the Sign-in-with-Imajin flow (src/lib/auth-config.ts). Same host as IMAJIN_KERNEL_URL.

name: IMAJIN_KERNEL_URL
summary: Kernel base URL (no path). Used by loadAppSigningKey() to fetch this app's signing key at boot, to mint this app's own app-service token (POST {IMAJIN_KERNEL_URL}/auth/api/apps/token/service) for pay checkout + settle, and by the kernel client.

name: PAY_SERVICE_URL
summary: Kernel pay service base URL, including the /pay prefix. Checkout sessions are created with POST {PAY_SERVICE_URL}/api/checkout; purchases fail with a 500 while it is unset.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH
summary: Reverse-proxy path prefix the app is mounted under. Must be `/market`. Baked at build time; rebuild after changing.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
summary: This app's public URL used for redirects and checkout callbacks. Scoped tokens use the registry slug `market`; webhook signatures use IMAJIN_APP_DID.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_URL
summary: Public URL of the kernel auth service the browser talks to (the "enter your email to buy" gate: GET /api/session, POST /api/onboard). Includes the /auth prefix. Baked at build time.

name: IMAJIN_APP_DID
summary: This app's own did:imajin:… from registration (docs/REGISTRATION.md). instrumentation.ts refuses to boot without it. Not a secret. Separate DID for dev and prod.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVICE_PREFIX
summary: Read by @ima-jin/config to build kernel/chat/media public URLs, including the /dashboard -> kernel hub redirect in middleware.ts. MUST be `dev-` on the dev instance (otherwise the redirect points at the prod kernel); leave unset on prod. Baked at build time; rebuild after changing.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_DOMAIN
summary: Companion to NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVICE_PREFIX (default imajin.ai). Leave at the default on both environments.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_MEDIA_URL
summary: Public base URL of the kernel media service, used to turn asset_* image refs into URLs and as the image-upload target (ima-jin/imajin-ai#2637). When unset it is derived from the service prefix/domain.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_NODE_DID
summary: This node's DID, shown in the .fair attribution accordion on a listing. Optional.

name: NODE_DID
summary: This node's DID: the recipient of the node fee in the .fair payee chain market declares at checkout (src/lib/settle.ts). Unset -> the node fee resolves to an unresolved sentinel DID and a warning is logged; set it on any node that settles purchases. Also read by @ima-jin/auth's node-act-as check.

name: IMAJIN_ENV
summary: Selects the kernel session cookie name in @ima-jin/config: `dev` -> imajin_session_dev, anything else -> imajin_session. MUST be `dev` on the dev instance (a production build is NODE_ENV=production, which does not imply dev); leave unset on prod.

name: IMAJIN_APP_KEYSTORE
summary: Path of this app's 0600 bootstrap keystore (never the vault key itself). Default ./.imajin/keystore.json relative to the process cwd. Must be writable, persist across deploys, and be separate for dev and prod.

name: IMAJIN_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
summary: Removed. The app throws at boot if this is set — the signing key comes from loadAppSigningKey(), never from env.

name: PORT
summary: Listen port. Set by the pm2 ecosystem entry (prod 7104, dev 3104); only used directly by `pnpm dev`.

name: NODE_ENV
summary: Set to `production` by the pm2 entry and by `next build`/`next start`. Do not set it in the env file.

name: NEXT_RUNTIME
summary: Injected by Next.js; instrumentation.ts only bootstraps the signing key when it is `nodejs`. Never set by hand.

name: LOG_LEVEL
summary: pino log level for @ima-jin/logger (default info). Output is stdout only; pm2 captures it.

name: ENABLE_REQUEST_LOG
summary: Logger request-log switch. Leave unset: this app wires no log sink (AGENTS.md — stdout only).

name: ENABLE_APP_LOG
summary: Logger persisted-log switch. Leave unset: this app never persists logs to a database.

name: LOG_DB_TRANSPORT
summary: Logger DB-transport switch. Leave unset: logging must never touch a data store (AGENTS.md).

name: APP_LOG_LEVEL
summary: Minimum level the logger would persist (default warn). Inert while persistence is off.

name: ATTESTATION_INTERNAL_API_KEY
summary: @ima-jin/auth act-as / attestation calls. market exercises neither; leave unset. Never hand-mint it.

name: AUTH_INTERNAL_API_KEY
summary: Deprecated @ima-jin/auth internal key (agent delegation). Not used by market; leave unset.

name: PROFILE_SERVICE_URL
summary: @ima-jin/auth credential resolution. Not used by market; leave unset.

name: PROFILE_INTERNAL_API_KEY
summary: @ima-jin/auth credential resolution key. Not used by market; leave unset.

name: APP_URL
summary: @ima-jin/auth fallback origin for redirects. market passes publicUrl explicitly (NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL); leave unset.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
summary: @ima-jin/auth fallback origin for redirects (after APP_URL). market does not rely on it; leave unset.

name: SESSION_COOKIE_SCOPE
summary: @ima-jin/config cookie-scope switch (`host` = host-only cookie). Leave unset: the shared kernel session cookie is the fallback auth path (docs/REGISTRATION.md section 6).

name: REGISTRY_SERVICE_URL
summary: @ima-jin/config registry lookup. Not used by market; leave unset.

name: REGISTRY_URL
summary: Deprecated alias of REGISTRY_SERVICE_URL in @ima-jin/config. Not used by market; leave unset.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_NOTIFY_URL
summary: @ima-jin/ui header: when set, shows the notification bell wired to the kernel notify service. Leave unset (no bell).

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_VERSION
summary: @ima-jin/ui footer build stamp: version label (default `dev`). Cosmetic; may be set at build time.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_HASH
summary: @ima-jin/ui footer build stamp: commit hash (default `local`). Cosmetic; may be set at build time.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_COMMIT_COUNT
summary: @ima-jin/ui footer build stamp: commit count (default empty). Cosmetic; may be set at build time.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAJIN_AUTH_URL
summary: Listed in the app template; no code in this repo reads it. Safe to omit.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAJIN_APP_ID
summary: Listed in the app template (registry `app_…` id); no code in this repo reads it. Safe to omit.

name: IMAJIN_APP_ATTESTATION_ID
summary: Listed in the app template (service-level attestation id for kernel calls outside a user session); no code in this repo reads it. Safe to omit.

name: VERIFY_BOOT_PORT
summary: Reserved for a CI boot check; unused today. Not used in deployment.
